safe_content_feature_requests.title: Initial Onboarding Tooltip Integration
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand controls and rules immediately upon starting their first route.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Without onboarding prompts, new players must guess how movement and combat interactions work.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display a brief introductory text box explaining walk and combat actions at the start of Moss Trail.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Exploration-Themed Route Modifiers and Revisit Incentives
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Encourages replayability on completed routes by introducing rotating collectible spawn bonuses.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Once a route like Gloomwood is beaten, there are limited gameplay reasons to return without dynamic exploration events or bonus tokens.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce periodic 'Forager's Moon' or discovery weather modifiers that increase rare collectible drop rates on specific older routes.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Elite Combat Encounters & Aggressive Enemy Profiles
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides a high-tension challenge that rewards mastery and strategic combat decision-making on difficult routes.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Current routes feature very few encounters relative to movement steps, reducing the mechanical depth of combat.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add tighter encounter spacing and content pack variants featuring aggressive enemy configurations on difficulty 3+ routes.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Elite Cosmetic Savings Milestone Bonus
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Rewards loyal players who accumulate funds over multiple route completions, closing the gap toward expensive items like the Waypoint Crown.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Currently, a single successful run leaves a wide deficit when aiming for high-end marketplace items after buying mid-tier gear.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary marketplace bonus or loyalty discount tier when players retain a specific coin threshold, accelerating elite purchases.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Keyboard Shortcut Indicators in UI Menus
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Improves navigation speed and clarity for desktop players using keyboard controls.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Clear visual prompts for key bindings reduce cognitive load and enhance mouse/keyboard usability.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear hotkey badges next to interface buttons and marketplace actions.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows the session began directly with walking actions on Moss Trail without prior tutorial prompts, matching development backlog item P2.
observations.recommendation: Implement welcome tooltips at step 0 to guide new players through initial movement and combat mechanics.

observations.evidence: The walk trace consistently progressed forward step-by-step to complete the Moss Trail and award 25 coins cleanly.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the clear step progression feedback for route completions.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow route and gathered basic completion reward coins, but lacked a dedicated in-game collection tracking interface for unique route items.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize the implementation of a Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI to enhance the incentive for gathering unique route collectibles.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped the 'trail_cap' cosmetic for 45 coins out of a total starting accumulation.
observations.recommendation: Expand the catalog with additional mid-tier exploration cosmetics and trail-themed badges to sustain collection goals.

observations.evidence: Frostfang Pass telemetry shows only 2 enemy encounters (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11) over a 12-step traversal.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy density and introduce consecutive or elite encounter patterns on difficulty 3 routes to match the Combat Challenger persona expectations.

observations.evidence: Completing Frostfang Pass rewarded 25 coins with zero HP lost (final HP 100), despite it being rated as difficulty 3.
observations.recommendation: Tie high-difficulty route rewards more closely to engagement risk and introduce scaling modifiers that reward skillful execution.

observations.evidence: Completed a full Treasure Run route, gathered one small coin pickup (+5), and received the completion payout (+25), totaling 30 coins earned per run. This required buying two mid-tier items sequentially, but left the player short on the elite tier item (Waypoint Crown), ending with 21 coins.
observations.recommendation: Adjust route completion coin payouts or add intermediate coin drops within longer routes to ensure players can smoothly transition from mid-tier cosmetics to elite crown purchases without encountering an abrupt spending wall.

observations.evidence: The market action properly handled a 'Not enough coins' state when attempting to purchase 'waypoint_crown' with 21 coins, leaving coins_after unchanged at 21.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the current strict transaction safety checks while potentially adding a wishlist or saving indicator to motivate repeat runs.

observations.evidence: Backlog item 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' notes marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus indicators for all interactive elements to support keyboard navigation and accessibility standards.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase of 'trail_cap' successfully completed, confirming coins deducted correctly and UI message displayed 'Purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins.'
observations.recommendation: Maintain clear, explicit transaction feedback messages upon marketplace purchases.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows two consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events at step 2 (`from_step: 2, to_step: 2`) with duplicate 'The obstacle blocks walking. Use Jump.' messages before the player successfully issued a Jump action.
observations.recommendation: Implement input command buffering or automatic action switching when a walk command is received against a blocked state to prevent redundant error spam.

bugs.title: Redundant Walk Commands Do Not Increment Step Counter on Blocked Obstacle
repro_steps: Walk forward until reaching an obstacle at step 2
Issue multiple walk commands without jumping
bugs.expected: Player position remains stable or movement command is rejected gracefully without duplicate message stacking.
bugs.observed: Multiple walk commands are accepted by the input parser while the player is blocked, resulting in duplicate error messages at step 2 (`from_step: 2, to_step: 2`) before jumping.
